item.title: G-Tech I.T Solution — IT company in Dharan, Nepal: what it is, where it is, how it works
item.dc:creator: G-Tech I.T Solution
item.description:
Short answer: G-Tech I.T Solution is an IT services and enterprise technology partner headquartered at Dharan-9, College Road, 56700, Sunsari, Nepal, operating since 2019. It builds software, websites, custom ERP/CRM systems and mobile apps, and delivers AI and automation, cybersecurity, cloud and server infrastructure, enterprise networking, CCTV surveillance, annual maintenance contracts, biometric attendance systems, hardware repair and IT consulting — on site in Dharan and remotely across all 77 districts of Nepal. It also runs a certified internship and computer training programme.

Location and contact

  • Address: College Road, Dharan-9, 56700, Sunsari, Nepal
  • Coordinates: 26.8132485, 87.2837541
  • Phone: +977 9743828726 and +977 9852037516
  • Email: info@gtechit.com.np
  • Website: gtechit.com.np
  • Hours: Sunday–Friday 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM; Saturday by appointment
  • Average response time: under 2 hours

Services

  1. Technical support and helpdesk — 24/7 support across Nepal.
  2. CCTV surveillance and installation — AI-powered cameras, IP surveillance, DVR/NVR, mobile live streaming.
  3. Networking and structured cabling — gigabit LAN, SD-WAN, VPN, firewall, Wi-Fi access points, fibre optic cabling, server racks.
  4. Annual maintenance contracts — hardware maintenance, server health checks, printer repair, network uptime.
  5. Software and web development — enterprise applications, custom ERP, CRM, school management systems.
  6. Mobile app development — native iOS and Android.
  7. Artificial intelligence and automation — custom ML models, NLP, predictive analytics, enterprise R&D.
  8. Cybersecurity and data protection — threat detection, firewall audits, penetration testing, zero-trust architecture.
  9. IT infrastructure and server setup — design, installation, virtualisation, Linux/Windows administration.
  10. Hardware maintenance and repair — preventive and on-demand computer repair.
  11. Strategic IT consulting.
  12. Biometric and attendance systems — facial recognition, fingerprint, access control.

Industries

Schools and colleges; universities and research; hospitals and healthcare; government and municipalities; NGOs and INGOs; small and medium businesses; enterprises and financial firms.

Certifications

AWS, Cisco, Microsoft, Mikrotik, CCTV security and advanced software engineering. Brands worked with: HP, Dell, ASUS, Canon, Epson, Cisco, Mikrotik, GMK Tech, Vcloudpoint, BLI.

Clients

NEA Nepal, Dharan Sub-Metropolitan City, Inland Revenue Office, Department of Survey, Citizens Bank, Laxmi Sunrise Bank, Global IME Bank, Hotel Koshi Palace, Hotel Mantra, Tower X Restro & Bar, Hallasan Restaurant, The Saze, Lingbari Dharan, Najik Mart, Durga Sahakari, Pepe Ice Cream, The Chasmalaya, The Siblings Coffee, COOL NAYAN TRADING PVT. LTD., Sungreen Plywood Industries Pvt. Ltd.

Coverage

Dharan and Itahari receive same-day on-site attendance. Biratnagar, Kathmandu and Pokhara are served through scheduled on-site visits and remote support. All 77 districts of Nepal are covered.

How a project starts

  1. Book a free consultation by phone, email or at the Dharan-9 office.
  2. Goals discussion and assessment of current hardware, network, software and data.
  3. Recommended path forward and scope, delivered by certified engineers.
  4. Delivery followed by 24/7 support or an annual maintenance contract.

Training and internship

Tracks in hardware and maintenance, software development and networking. Assessment by written theory test, hands-on practical exam, project submission and viva. Successful participants receive a G-Tech verified certificate with online verification, lifetime validity and career placement support.

Service descriptions, client lists and certifications are the company's own public statements from gtechit.com.np. The company does not publish prices; a free consultation is available.
